When invoked, `AbstractTransformFuture.run()` (lines 67-173) fetches the input's result via `getDone`, then calls the abstract `doTransform` method, which `TransformFuture.doTransform` (lines 252-256) implements by applying `function.apply(input)` — the actual function application. Finally `run()` calls `setResult(transformResult)`, implemented by `TransformFuture.setResult` (lines 258-261), which calls `set(result)` to complete the output future.
